name: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

description.value:
Restore 2 Energy at your turn start. Deal +2 damage against enemies with an implanted weakness. Once per turn, a hit forces a Constitution save; failure gives AC −1 for 2 turns.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching erudition Path required.

source.custom: Honkai: Star Rail / Telys D&D conversion
